# Luxora Villa

> Luxury 3-bedroom private-pool villa in Pereybere, Grand Baie, North Mauritius. Rated 9.3/10 on Booking.com.

Luxora Villa is a brand-new holiday villa rental with private pool, jacuzzi and rooftop terrace, minutes from Pereybere Beach and Grand Baie's restaurants, shops and nightlife. Sleeps up to 6 guests across 3 air-conditioned bedrooms.
